name: Little Moses Jones
configRangeLabel: Six piece, with its own sound engineer
alt: The band on stage in red under purple light, two singers out front and a tuba beside the keys.
blurb: If your crowd grew up on Usher, TLC, Outkast, Missy Elliott, Lauryn Hill and Warren G, Little Moses Jones is the band to book. It's a six-piece band, and they rap the verses live. The band brings its own sound engineer, so you usually won't need a separate audio company, and they can keep the lyrics clean when you need that. It's a great choice for holiday parties, galas, weddings and milestone birthdays.
identity: Little Moses Jones has two lead singers out front, and behind them the bandleader plays keys and horns with guitar, bass and drums. They play straight through with no gaps between songs, which helps keep people out on the dance floor.

The song list also includes Destiny's Child, Mary J. Blige, Nelly and Montell Jordan, along with the soul and funk songs that inspired them, and we can put the setlist together around your crowd. For a late-night party, they can play the uncensored versions, too.

The band has been playing live for nearly two decades. It has played for Google, Pearson and a Denver Broncos pregame, at galas for the Boys and Girls Club and the Denver Children's Foundation, and at festivals like Parker Days, Burro Days and Juneteenth in Thornton. The band has also played shows in Amsterdam and Mexico. In 2022 the LUXlife awards named it Colorado's wedding band of the year.
Little Moses Jones is a Denver band that can play the Front Range and the mountain towns, too.
